question: Does one fixed learner-state expert-label aggregation round yield useful navigation for every augmented original-graph seed on new reserved scenes?
scope: One reduced MaleCNS simulator/software interface; no topology, biology, hardware or automatic R3 promotion.

generator.future_disjointness: Before any authorized held-out model run, generate only its reserved cases under these exact bytes; reject canonical scene/initial-observation and complete payload duplicates against all earlier train/dev/evaluation rosters and new train/dev. No replacement seed, repositioning, altered generator or duplicate-dependent selection. Same declared scene across matched arms/seeds must intentionally match; that pairing is not a distinct scene.

reserves.id_disjointness_check: Existing JSON plan/data-manifest seed keys have no overlap; this is not geometric/payload disjointness. Never use these seeds in a toy, smoke or tuning run.

fixed_source_models.selected: Exactly original graph seed10/11/12 from admitted recovery bundles; no control or winning-seed choice

collection.initialization: Fresh seeded episode, zero student hidden, full fresh teacher fingerprint; one immutable source learner per owner. No reset, action blend, prefix, perturbation, teacher takeover or coverage-censoring stop.
collection.once_per_interval: Query unchanged teacher exactly once at the pre-action state; record final returned float32 expert action and before/after recovery counters/replacement transitions. Engine then executes the frozen learner normal policy path once; no action_override and no duplicate recurrent advance.
collection.targets: New rows target the canonical returned expert action. Actual executed student action/control is independently retained, never relabelled expert. Old134 recovery rows keep their actual executed targets, including prefix differences.
collection.observations: Unchanged388 effective RGB/contact/bearing inputs only; same pre-action observation recorded for expert-labelled student feature. Teacher world/planner/PID/pose and diagnostic contact arrays are audit metadata, never student features. Eye rendering excludes teacher drawing overlays.
collection.boundaries: Publish every complete admitted interval before guard/outcome stop. Valid goal/collision/stalled/time_limit endings retained at1..600rows without minimum-length selection, crop or replacement. No v3 coverage_complete stop; failed/corrupt/unsafe source stops the stage with remaining not_started.
collection.teacher_advice_limitation: Pinned Teacher.act recovery counter advances per query, even though learner ignores returned recovery actions. These are unchanged analytic-teacher advice on learner history, not proved expert-correct labels or executed recovery; extra labels need not cure private-state/observability mismatch.
collection.query_isolation_guard: Before admitting each interval, bind pre/post teacher query native state, effective student observation/feature bytes and relevant Python/NumPy/engine/Torch RNG states. All must remain equal; separately record intentional bounded teacher-private transitions and path_to_draw/target_to_draw overlays. Require pinned eye-render overlay isolation plus actual recorded input equality. Never repair by teleport/reset/alternate expert/takeover.

contacts.intended_rover_obstacle_pairs: Exact unordered Cartesian product of five collision-enabled named robot geoms and20named obstacle geoms:100pairs; identities verified against compiled model ownership.
contacts.study_admission: Retain all pairs/distances/classes/times in10pre-control stages plus unchanged end cache. Named intended obstacle contacts remain actual geometric contacts in observations/outcomes; no force/control edit, contact suppression, termination rewrite or renderer change. World-only pairs retained separately and may move. Floor/base, floor/fork, marker, self, wall, unknown/misowned robot pair or incomplete/nonfinite/overflow packet stops infrastructure.
contacts.implementation: New named study validator consumes unchanged ContactProbe packets. Never broaden old collect_male_recovery.contact_admission or body-profile guards. Same fixed study admission applies to collection/dev/held-out native owners.
contacts.limitation: Cached contact sensor and stage-zero contact are distinct;10discrete caches are not continuous collision coverage.

data.old_arm: Old2117train/1228recorded-dev unchanged; new fresh fit, not reused checkpoint predictions.
data.augmented_arm: Old2117train followed by all admitted new expert-labelled sources in declared collection order; same unchanged1228recorded-dev. No weighting, balancing, oversampling, sample removal or source filtering.
data.sequence: Zero hidden for each source, carry/detach at32-row windows including final partial window; no padding, terminal bootstrap or cross-source hidden carry. Preserve old67-row censored sources exactly32/32/3; new natural/cap endings labelled distinctly.
data.admission: Separately named immutable research manifest binds source/profile/label kind and actual/expert metadata plus all source/features/targets. Reject duplicate complete new feature-target streams and cross-split/corpus scene/payload contamination before training; no loader fallback or production/v2 loader widening.

learning.graph_variant: original only in both arms; no rewire call
learning.paired_initialization: Same declared seed and original graph initialization per old/augmented pair; separate fresh models.
learning.selection: Earliest strict minimum unchanged1228-row recorded-dev loss over exactly20epochs; all6checkpoints freeze before new closed-loop dev; no seed/arm/held-out selection.
learning.confound: Augmented corpus increases optimizer updates per epoch as well as learner-state/expert-label coverage; this fixed study does not isolate either causal mechanism.

closed_loop.order: scene increasing, model seed10/11/12, old-corpus then augmented
closed_loop.one_run: Fresh zero-hidden episode, one checkpoint once per interval, unmasked eyes, no privileged teacher query/input, reset, intervention, action override or rescue; max600ticks.
closed_loop.success: Unchanged native last_outcome.reason==goal within600ticks under admitted controls/contact records. All natural non-goal outcomes count as failures; no early/late outcome rewrite.
closed_loop.dev_unlock: All24runs complete with normal process/disjointness/source/finite/guard/storage admission AND every augmented seed has>=3goals among4freshdevscenes. Failure keeps held-out geometry/paths/model execution unopened.
closed_loop.held_out_criterion: All48runs complete with normal admission AND every augmented seed has>=6goals among8reservedheld-out scenes. Report old-arm counts and paired per-scene differences too; no post-result comparative threshold, pooling, winning seed or topology claim.
closed_loop.meaning: Meets only this prospectively declared simulator navigation criterion; R3 status remains an explicit release-review decision, never automatic.

camera_contact_numeric_estimate.formula: Four128x128RGBuint8 cameras +32KiB contact/body arrays +8KiB remaining fields; actual fields must recheck before first numeric step, refuse if insufficient.

limits.disk_risk: Previous planning observation~27GiBfree minus~10GiBestimatedremainingmemorymatrix leaves little room versus16.5625GiBadditional reserve; prospective fresh full admission may block. Never delete retained evidence or loosen budgets to run.

implementation_next: After plan review only: one named learner-state collector/admission plus thin paired-original trainer and trusted study Binding/evaluation entrypoint using existing helpers. Preserve production/v2/recovery loaders/protocols and immutable old producers; no generic registry or public profile toggle.
stop_policy: No retries/replacement/tuning/second round. All fixed natural outcomes retained; functional gate scored only after all stage owners. First infrastructure/source/label/geometry/payload/contact/finite/storage/deadline/cleanup failure stops later work, preserves raw first failure/not_started rows and cannot publish admissible success. Source/data before/after and all final payloads synced/normalprocess before report admission; outer finite PID/start drain, no nested writer leases.
